sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: passing a non-Copy value by value transfers it, and any later use is rejected at compile time.
sketches.resonance: What has been truly given away cannot be given again without becoming an error.

sketches.mechanism: SQL three-valued logic: comparison with NULL yields UNKNOWN, so the WHERE clause admits no row.
sketches.resonance: The unknown cannot confirm even its own reflection.
sketches.draft:
SELECT 1 AS mirror
WHERE NULL = NULL;

sketches.mechanism: Empty type elimination: an impossible value of an uninhabited type can produce any type, but no caller can supply it.
sketches.resonance: From absolute absence, anything may be promised and nothing can be delivered.
sketches.draft:
data Absence : Type where

fromAbsence : Absence -> a
fromAbsence x impossible
